basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Trauma and Emergency Medicine at All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal, is hiring one Project Technical Support III on contract for a Department of Health Research (DHR) project under the Young Medical Faculty (YMF) Ph.D. Program 2026, at a consolidated Rs. 28,000 per month plus 20% HRA. Applications are submitted through a Google Form, three days before the tentative interview date of 4 December 2026. Only Indian Nationals may apply, and the application fee is Nil.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal is located at Saket Nagar, Bhopal (MP) 462020. This post belongs to an extra-mural research project sanctioned to Dr. Babu Lal, Associate Professor, Department of Trauma and Emergency Medicine, who is the Principal Investigator. The project falls under the HRD Scheme of the Department of Health Research.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the vacancy.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is below 35 years as on the last date of application. The vacancy table says age relaxation for SC/ ST candidates will be applicable as per rule. The age relaxation paragraph says it is admissible to SC/ST/OBC candidates, Departmental Candidates (including project staff), and in accordance with instructions issued by the Central Government/ICMR from time to time. It is subject to submission of the relevant supporting documents along with the original application. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Candidates already in government service must submit a No Objection Certificate from the present employer. The prescribed qualification is the minimum; possessing it does not entitle a candidate to selection. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: 1. Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + three Years post qualification experience or PG in relevant subject / field. Or 2. For Engineering / IT / CS - Four Years Graduate Degree.
rows.desirable: Prior experience in CAD/CAM, 3D Modelling, Computational Analysis/Simulation/FEA will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated pay is 28000/- + 20% HRA per month. The tenure is 1 Year or can be extendible up to the availability of the project grant. The assignment is purely on contract basis. The contract expires automatically on completion of the period unless renewed with mutual consent for the decided period. Either side can end it at any time by giving 7 days' notice or salary in lieu. Leave follows the AIIMS Bhopal leave policy governing extramural / short term research projects, as amended from time to time. No hostel or other accommodation will be provided by the Institute or the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support III
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the AIIMS Bhopal website ( www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in ) and fill it in, writing the post applied for as Project Technical Support III. Scan the educational qualification certificates, experience certificates and the No Objection Certificate (NOC), wherever applicable. Combine all supporting documents into a single PDF file. Submit the filled form with the PDF through the Google Form only: https://forms.gle/QxCpZBFMdxGSkvqm8 Submit it three (03) days prior to the tentative date of the Interview. Late, incomplete or non-prescribed-format applications will not be considered. For queries, contact [email protected] . Self-attested photocopies of proof of date of birth (Class 10th certificate). Mark sheets and degree certificates of the essential qualification. Experience certificates. Registration certificate of the qualifying degree with the statutory council (wherever applicable). Category certificate for age relaxation. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer, if employed in Government service. At the written examination/interview: the original duly filled application form, original certificates, two recent passport size colour photographs and one set of self-attested photocopies.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through an Interview by the Selection Committee. The Committee decides whether the Interview is Online or Offline. If more than 30 eligible candidates apply for the post, a Written Examination of 20 multiple-choice questions carrying 20 marks is held on the day of the Interview. Qualifying marks in that Written Examination are SC/ST: 35% and UR/OBC/EWS: 40%. Candidates securing the qualifying marks or above are shortlisted for the Interview, limited to the top 10 candidates in the Written Examination for each post. The final merit list is prepared on the marks obtained in the Written Examination and the Interview. If fewer than 30 eligible candidates report, the Written Examination is not held, the Interview is in hybrid mode (Online/Offline), and the final merit list is based solely on Interview marks. The tentative date for the Written Examination/Interview is 4 December 2026. Date, time, mode and venue will be communicated separately to shortlisted candidates by email. The result will be displayed on the AIIMS Bhopal website, and the selected candidate must join within seven (07) days from the date of issuance of the Offer Letter.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support III recruitment?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy (01) for Project Technical Support III under the DHR Young Medical Faculty (YMF) Ph.D. Program 2026 project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the Google Form with all documents is three (03) days prior to the tentative interview date, which is 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support III?
faq.answer: A Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field plus three years post qualification experience, or PG in relevant subject / field. For Engineering / IT / CS, a Four Years Graduate Degree is accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years as on the last date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Project Technical Support III at AIIMS Bhopal?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is 28000/- per month plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is any application fee payable?
faq.answer: No. The notice states the application fee as Nil.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the application form, combine it with the certificates and NOC (where applicable) in a single PDF, and submit through the Google Form only.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: A 20-question, 20-mark multiple-choice Written Examination is held on the interview day only if more than 30 eligible candidates apply. Otherwise selection is by interview alone.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job, and for how long is the contract?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract post for 1 Year or extendible up to the availability of the project grant, and gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: Relaxation is admissible to SC/ST/OBC candidates and Departmental Candidates (including project staff), as per Central Government/ICMR instructions, with supporting documents submitted with the application.
